meta.title: Refactor OSM cache benchmarking helpers
meta.body_summary: Break out OSM cache provider loading and engine benchmarking into helpers, add a performance-metrics computation helper, and refactor benchmark_routing_performance.

perf_labels.notes: Large refactor (4196 lines) of OSM cache benchmarking helpers with C and Python changes; zero reviews and no performance evidence; merged by sole maintainer after 86 hours with an import error in pytest.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 4196 changed lines, this is a large refactor by absolute volume, spanning core C engine code, Python bindings, and test infrastructure. As a performance benchmarking refactor, the large size is justified by scope, and the merge without review fits a solo-maintainer project where the author drove both the AI-generated changes and the final integration.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comment text provided; PR was merged without any documented review feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Refactored benchmarking helpers to ease performance testing, but no numeric performance claim is made.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large-scale refactor across C and Python code was merged without human review, indicating a process where the sole maintainer trusts AI-generated code for structural improvements in a personal project.

detection_detail.code_reading: No documented code review; PR author is the sole maintainer who self-merged the changes.
detection_detail.ci_auto: No CI integration signals; PR body notes pytest fails due to import error, yet merge proceeded.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark table, profiler mention, or working test command. The PR body states 'pytest -q (fails: cannot import graphserver)', indicating the testing instructions are not reproducible as given.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR merged without reported regressions; no review feedback requiring fixes.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored OSM cache benchmarking by extracting provider loading and engine benchmarking into separate helper functions; added a dedicated performance metrics computation helper; updated benchmark_routing_performance; also introduced a precaching feature with BFS, Python bindings, and corresponding tests; removed obsolete scripts and examples; formatted with ruff.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Removed scripts and examples that were migrated to tests; added new precaching feature and tests; formatting and style updates across many files.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: refactored benchmarking helpers in osm_cache_performance_test.py.
Added access providers using access points and updated tests.
Refactored identity hash tests and updated core.py.
Moved one-off scripts into proper test system.
Refined OSM cache performance test with route creation improvements.
Added C-level precaching functionality with BFS and C tests.
Decomposed engine.c function into helpers and patched memory leaks.
Added Python bindings for precaching, including example and tests.
Multiple ruff format and ruff check fix commits.

collaboration_trajectory: Sole maintainer submitted AI-generated PR with 17 incremental commits; no human reviewers were engaged; PR merged after 86 hours with no documented discussion.
